name: The Gambler
notes: Known from one free-agent sample posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 19 September 1998, titled "[Free Agent] Could he be coming to a fed near you?", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-could-he-be-coming-to-a-fed-near-you-1998-09-19.html, in which his handler says he is thinking of bringing the character back after writing a roleplay for the JRMC. In an alley behind the Hoosier Dome a dishevelled, unshaven Gambler lights a cigarette with a Zippo, grumbles that he signed the contract drunk, reads a crumpled Memorial Card listing Verhoeven, Van Strife, Creed, Mathews and Joe Reed, burns it, and says he will use the tournament to build a new generation of wrestlers and federations. The handler's signature gives him as 27-2-3 and retired.
caption: A dishevelled drunk-signed entrant in the Memorial Card tournament who burns the card and vows to build a new generation, in September 1998.
